name: agents-core
description: Agents-Core plugins for specialist personas, reusable workflows and repository memory.

plugins.name: agents-core
plugins.description: Specialist personas, workflows and repository memory through a separately installed local MCP server. Requires macOS or Linux and Python 3.11+.

plugins.name: agents-core-context-compaction
plugins.description: Optional native Claude Code compaction between successful main turns, controlled by a separate owner setting that defaults to off. No separate API key.
